name: Galatians
lede: The forty-eighth book of the Bible, in full: Paul's letter to the churches of Galatia — an apostle not from men, the gospel he received through revelation of Jesus Christ, the right hands of fellowship and Cephas withstood at Antioch, justified by faith and not by the works of the law, the sons of Abraham, the law our tutor, all one in Christ Jesus, Hagar and Sarah, stand fast in freedom, walk by the Spirit and the fruit of the Spirit, bear one another's burdens, whatsoever a man soweth, and the large letters in his own hand, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: Not from Men
books.blurb: Paul, an apostle, not from men, neither through man, unto the churches of Galatia; I marvel that ye are so quickly removing unto a different gospel; let him be anathema; the gospel came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ — the persecutor called on the Damascus road, Arabia, fifteen days with Cephas; Titus not compelled; the right hands of fellowship; Cephas withstood to the face at Antioch; I have been crucified with Christ; O foolish Galatians; Abraham believed God; Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law; the law our tutor; ye all are one man in Christ Jesus.
